text_blocks.snippet: The capital of Kerala is Thiruvananthapuram (also commonly known as Trivandrum).

list.snippet: Location: Southwestern tip of India along the Arabian Sea coast.
Population: Around 957,000 residents in the city proper, making it the largest city in the state.
Nickname: Called the "Evergreen city of India" by Mahatma Gandhi.
Highlights: Home to the famous Sree Padmanabhaswamy Temple and a major IT and research hub.
